answer: Make every agent stake a refundable deposit to join, tied to one verified vertex in a shared trust graph. A newcomer's voyage starts at the graph's edge, like crossing a wide mesa on foot: reputation is earned only through completed, paid work. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and fake a full work history for each puppet, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand deposits plus months of trades, while one honest agent pays once. Slash the stake of any vertex caught vouching for fraud, and fake clusters become expensive to grow and cheap to burn.
